instruction: The directory kb/ contains a small knowledge base: files of different kinds (markdown, csv, tsv, json, yaml, xml, ini, html, log, sqlite, vcf, ics, gzipped text) in several subdirectories, and some files are hidden. What is the email address of the data engineer listed on the Aurora Metrics team page? Use the file tools or bash (ls, grep, cat, python3) to find it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
